name: documenso
packageManager: npm@11.19.1 (packageManager field; used the npm 11.19.0 bundled with Node 24.21.0, which satisfies engines.npm >=11.17.0; CI runs `corepack enable npm`)
browserRevisionExpected: chromium 1194: matches the installed browsers, so PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers with no shim
install: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/documenso/documenso && cd documenso  # at the commit above
cp .env.example .env   # as CI does; values are overridden by the env below (dotenv and dotenv-cli do not override existing env)
npm ci --no-audit   # 181 s; postinstall runs patch-package
build: npx turbo run build --filter=@documenso/remix   # first half of `npm run ci`; 514 s here (8m34). It runs lingui extract, which rewrites 11 tracked packages/lib/translations/*/web.po files (a build side effect, not a manual edit)

env.NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBAPP_URL: http://localhost:3103   (runtime, read via env(); also the Playwright baseURL; not inlined into the build, checked)
env.NEXT_PRIVATE_SMTP_PORT: 11025 (mailpit with --smtp-auth-accept-any --smtp-auth-allow-insecure; .env.example uses smtp-auth transport with user/password; CI used inbucket)
env.CI: true (config: retries 4, maxFailures 1, forbidOnly; overridden on the CLI with --retries=0 --max-failures=0)
env.NODE_OPTIONS: --import tsx (test process only, from the test:e2e script)
env.DANGEROUS_BYPASS_RATE_LIMITS: NOT SET in these runs. CI sets it to 'true' for both server and tests; this scout's tool permission check refused to set it, so the runs used real rate limiting (see notes)

migrate: npm run prisma:migrate-dev   (repo root; dotenv -e .env -e .env.local -- prisma migrate dev --skip-seed; reads NEXT_PRIVATE_DATABASE_URL / NEXT_PRIVATE_DIRECT_DATABASE_URL)
seed: npm run prisma:seed   (seeds example@documenso.com and others plus a 'medium account' with 1000 documents; migrate+seed took 46 s)
appStart: npm run start -w @documenso/remix   (from repo root; = dotenv ... cross-env NODE_ENV=production node build/server/main.js in apps/remix; honours PORT). The repo's test:e2e wraps it in start-server-and-test waiting on the literal http://localhost:3000, so here the app was started separately and playwright was run directly
baselineCommand: cd packages/app-tests && NODE_OPTIONS='--import tsx' NODE_ENV=test npx playwright test --project=api --workers=1 --retries=0 --max-failures=0 --reporter=list

baseline.flakyNotes: PARTIAL: `api` project only (507 of the suite's 1200 tests; ui = 681, license = 12 were NOT run in full). One run: 458 passed, 15 failed, 10 skipped, 24 did not run (15.6m). `skipped` = 10 skipped + 24 did-not-run serial followers. Load average 9-12 during the run. Assertion values in the 15 failures: 6x 'Received: null' (search-templates/search-documents lookups), 4x 'Received: 401' where 200 was expected (analytics-access 'allowed' control cases), 1x 'Received: 429' where 401 was expected (find-inbox.spec.ts:417), 1x false (find-inbox.spec.ts:61), 1x toContain miss (api/v2/find-documents.spec.ts:806), and 2 org rate-limit specs that only run when the bypass is off (api/v1/organisation-rate-limits.spec.ts:428, api/v2/organisation-rate-limits.spec.ts:630: 'Quota rejection should not add an org X-RateLimit-Limit, got "1000"'). The 429 and the rate-limit specs point at running without CI's DANGEROUS_BYPASS_RATE_LIMITS=true, with every request coming from 127.0.0.1. The null/401 cases may be rate-limited sign-ins or reads, but that is NOT verified: no rerun was done with the flag. UI sample: `--project=ui e2e/user` (18 tests): 15 passed, 3 failed, 2.4m, wall 148 s. All 3 failures are password.spec.ts:9,113,171 doing page.goto('http://localhost:3000/...') -> ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED (hardcoded port).

configuredWorkers: workers: 10 globally; per-project: api 10, license 1, ui calculateWorkers() = min(6, max(1, floor(max(cpus-2,1)/2))) = 1 on this 4-vCPU box
unmanagedServices: SMTP sink (inbucket in CI; mailpit here). Tests do not read mail
gotenberg (document conversion) and minio (S3) in the dev compose: unused with NEXT_PUBLIC_UPLOAD_TRANSPORT=database and no conversion URL
redis: only needed for the BullMQ jobs provider; the default local jobs provider does not use it
apps/remix/.documenso-license.json (a file, not a service): written by the license specs
hardcodedUrlsInTests: package.json test:e2e: start-server-and-test waits on literal http://localhost:3000
playwright.config.ts:44 baseURL fallback http://localhost:3000 (overridden by NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBAPP_URL)
authSetup: per-test: apiSignin() (e2e/fixtures/authentication.ts) fetches /api/auth/csrf and POSTs /api/auth/email-password/authorize into the page's request context. Sessions are DB-backed. Users and documents are created per test with the prisma seed helpers in the test process (@documenso/prisma/seed/*). The config-level storageState only carries a __disable_animations cookie for domain 'localhost'. No globalSetup, no setup project.
notes: FULL SUITE IS LONG: 1200 tests in 135 files. At workers=1 here the api project alone took 15.6 min; ui (681 browser tests at ~2-11 s each) was not run in full and would likely take over an hour. That is far above Experiment A's 5-min baseline@1 limit: HANDOFF material, or use a directory subset.

CI's DANGEROUS_BYPASS_RATE_LIMITS=true was not applied (permission refusal in this session). Without it the IP rate limiter is live and every worker shares 127.0.0.1. Under N parallel workers against separate apps each app has its own in-DB rate-limit counters, but the org rate-limit specs assume one server. Decide explicitly whether to set it (CI does, and the rate-limit specs then skip themselves).

The test process imports @documenso/prisma and @documenso/lib and reads NEXT_PRIVATE_DATABASE_URL from its own env (the config also loads ../../.env, .env.local and .env.<NODE_ENV> without override). Per-worker DB routing must set NEXT_PRIVATE_DATABASE_URL (and NEXT_PUBLIC_WEBAPP_URL for the fixtures' absolute URLs) in each worker before spec files load.

The test process registers the local jobs provider's cron jobs on import ('[JOBS]: Registered cron job internal.seal-document-sweep ...' in the Playwright output), so each worker also runs job sweeps against its DB.

Shared file state: the license project writes apps/remix/.documenso-license.json in the checkout. It is read by every app instance started from that checkout. The config pins that project to workers: 1 for this reason.

Port 3000 appears as a literal in password.spec.ts and in the test:e2e start-server-and-test URL. Running on any other port fails those 3 tests. Running N apps means at most one can be on 3000, and this sandbox's other agents use 3000.
The seed creates a 1000-document 'medium account'. It is part of the template DB, so CREATE DATABASE ... TEMPLATE copies it for every worker.

Postgres 16.13 used (compose uses postgres:15); migrate dev and seed were fine. max_connections was raised to 300 (the config comment says the api project at 10 workers is 'limited by DB connections').
The server is a process tree (npm -> sh -> dotenv -> cross-env -> node build/server/main.js); started under setsid and stopped with kill -- -<pgid>.
